title: The Mist Age - Equipment
description: Daggerheart inventory laid out the way it is carried: what a character wears on top, what is at hand, and containers such as a backpack with their contents by category, nested inside one another. Clothing and backpacks are put on like armor; their capacity bonus counts only while worn.

recommends.reason: Weight in slots and carrying capacity: worn items take no slots and containers show how full they are.
